correctness.rationale: For each matching of 2m coordinates, equations x_i+x_j=0 define P^{m-1} inside the Fermat cubic since opposite cubes cancel. For any nonempty subset of matchings, the union-edge graph imposes alternating signs; each connected bipartite component contributes one scalar, nonbipartite components are forced zero in characteristic !=2. Thus every intersection is P^{b-1} or empty, giving a field-independent integer-polynomial motivic inclusion-exclusion class Q_m(L). Over odd finite fields, a nonzero coordinate vector lies on some designated plane exactly when zero coordinates occur in even number and nonzero values occur in opposite pairs with matching multiplicities. Exponential coefficient extraction counts all vectors including zero as (2m)![t^{2m}]cosh(t)Phi(t)^((q-1)/2); subtract 1 and divide by q-1 for projective points. Equality with Q_m(q) for infinitely many odd q proves polynomial equality P_m=Q_m, hence the Grothendieck class over every field char !=2,3, and extension counts yield zeta. Independent rational coefficient reconstruction gives P1=1, P2=3z, P3=15z²−30z+25, P4=105z³−525z²+1120z−917, matching the frozen proof; finite experiments alone are not used to infer arbitrary m.
residual_risks: Char2 excluded because alternating-sign graph consistency fails; char3 excluded for smooth Fermat ambient cubic, not because intersection formula itself requires 3 invertible.
Only selected sign-pairing subspaces, not all (possibly 405) cubic-fourfold planes; Grothendieck class does not fix individual cohomology.

value.rationale: The perfect-matching coordinate planes are canonical subspaces of Fermat cubics, and their reduced union is a natural geometric arrangement with nontrivial overlap. A single explicit all-dimension Grothendieck class and Hasse–Weil zeta products solve exact natural motivic and enumerative invariants; the proof supplies genuine signed-component combinatorics and a generating-series bridge, not a mere isolated small table. This value stands independently of any conjectured downstream theorem.
residual_risks: Not a classification of every linear space on Fermat cubics; a known arrangement identity could limit historical novelty if later located.
